about: Shipped version 1 plus answer rules for All Is Dust, Selective Obliteration and Kozilek's Return, from the league of twelve (league-run #3).

playbook.notes: Version 2 = the shipped version 1 (its trigger rules and its twelve cast rules, unchanged and in their order: now rules 6 to 17; no attack block, as shipped) with five rules in front for the deck's sweepers, which version 1 left to Forge. Written from the 200 games of the league of twelve (league-run #3, seed 20261250), where the seat won 50. Drawn (games), cast, and in hand on the seat's last own turn of a loss: All Is Dust 51, 16, 18; Selective Obliteration 56, 2, 30 (AI:RemoveDeck:All: Forge never casts it from hand); Kozilek's Return 57, 29, 13. Rules 1-2, All Is Dust: each player sacrifices every coloured permanent, and nearly all of this deck is colourless or devoid (Ulalek included; the coloured permanents are Garruk's Uprising, Awakening Zone and Imprisoned in the Moon), so it is a one-sided wipe. In the league's casts it took 5 to 14 opposing creatures and none to two of ours, and the seat won 13 of the 16 games in which it was cast. Losses with it in hand had 7 to 10 lands beside opposing boards of 8 to 40 creatures (g00253, g00114, g00419, g00464, g00345, g00147). Cast as soon as one opponent has four creatures (the Hail, Caesar threshold for its one-sided Ruinous Ultimatum) or could hit for 12. Rules 3-4, Selective Obliteration: each player keeps only colourless permanents and those of the one colour they choose; multicoloured permanents (commanders such as Caesar or Emmara) go whatever is chosen. Near one-sided for this deck, weaker than All Is Dust against a single-colour opponent (Goblin Storm, Wretched Ranks lose nothing), so it waits for a bigger board: five creatures or a threat of 15. Below All Is Dust so that the full wipe goes first when both can be cast. Rule 5, Kozilek's Return (2 to each creature; it also kills our Scions and Spawn, which are mana, and Glaring Fleshraker): Forge casts it in about half the games it draws it; held at 13 losses, beside opposing token boards of 7 to 50. Cast at sorcery speed once one opponent has five creatures. Not written: Crib Swap, Imprisoned in the Moon, Eldrazi Confluence, Warping Wail, Ugin's -3, Endbringer and Drowner of Hope need targets on the other side; Forge picks them and already casts or uses most (Crib Swap 38 of 50, Warping Wail 51 of 58, Ugin 43 of 62, Imprisoned 24 of 58, Confluence 16 of 53). Ulamog's Nullifier counters at instant speed, outside the rules' reach. Previous notes (version 1): Eldrazi Incursion (Ulalek, Fused Atrocity: whenever you cast an Eldrazi spell, you may pay {C}{C} to copy every spell and every other ability you control). Stock Forge never pays Ulalek's trigger (0 copies in 12 audit games, 63 triggers put on the stack) and casts Ulalek on its own turn 6.5 on average. Rules: Sol Ring, then Ulalek at once, then the other rocks (a rock cast first had cost Ulalek a turn); Sire of Stagnation only while Ulalek is not on the battlefield (held otherwise), because copies of Sire draw two per Sire per opponent land and milled the seat in a tuning game (seven copies); the cost reducers and engines (Herald's Horn, Forsaken Monument, Ugin, Awakening Zone, Garruk's Uprising, Mystic Forge, Dreamstone Hedron), then the creatures dearest first; Ulamog's Dreadsire's 10/10 after combat (vigilance); the draw spells while 30 cards remain; Idol of Oblivion's 10/10 and its draw. Eldrazi Monument is held until five creatures, two of them tokens: its upkeep sacrifice ate Ulalek and the board in a tuning game. Trigger: Ulalek's copy paid while Forge estimates 10 mana or less left, declined above. Each copy of the trigger copies every spell on the stack again, so accepting without the cap doubled one creature spell into a thousand copies and two of twelve games ran into the clock as draws and one into the turn cap; the mana bound caps a chain at about five payments. Go-wide attack from two attackers up. Goldfish: audit seeds 15002-15013 stock 11.33, this file 10.25; tuning seeds 15022-15041 stock 11.65, this file 10.45 (+1.20, 95% +0.76 to +1.64). Validation, seeds 15101-15140, not looked at before the rules were final: stock 11.85 (40 of 40 finished), this file 10.42 (38 of 40), +1.21 turns on the 38 paired seeds (95% +0.74 to +1.68), faster in 24, same in 12, slower in 2. The two unfinished games hit the turn cap: on seed 15132 the mana cap did not stop a chain (Elder Deep-Fiend copied 255 times), and Garruk's Uprising drew a card for each copy until the seat was milled at 126 life. Forge's mana estimate seems to leave out Spawn and Scion sacrifices doubled by Forsaken Monument. Seed 15104 stayed on one land all game. Shipped on 2026-11-12 as version 1 with the attack left to Forge: at 200 tables of bots (ab-run #24, seed 20261230) 64 wins against the stock pilot's 62 (+1.0 points, 95% -7 to +9: level); 52 with the go-wide attack. Open defect: a chain of copies can deck the seat.
